points.identity_evidence: Southern tributary joins Lamey Brook west of the north–south road; upstream main has tight westward loop, downstream main crosses road then bends northeast to River Inhabitants. Historical thick single waterline compared with modern bank junction introduces bank/centreline uncertainty. Separate modern eastern tributary J0121 is east of this point and not this western fork.

scope: Central northern-edge physical check, with bank/centreline uncertainty.
